title: Killai Becomes Tamil Nadu’s First Climate-Resilient Village
summary: Killai in Cuddalore district became Tamil Nadu’s first fully operational Climate Resilient Village on 22 July 2026. The project was implemented under the Tamil Nadu Climate Change Mission of the Department of Environment and Climate Change ...

blocks.content: Killai in Cuddalore district became Tamil Nadu’s first fully operational Climate Resilient Village on 22 July 2026. The project was implemented under the Tamil Nadu Climate Change Mission of the Department of Environment and Climate Change and used ecosystem restoration, renewable energy , and community-led climate action.

items: The canal work included desilting and removal of plastic waste.
The project also involved removal of invasive Prosopis juliflora.
More than 3,000 native mangrove saplings were planted in the area.
The village plan includes solar panels in public buildings, street lights, solar parks, solar driers, and cold storage facilities.
The Buckingham Canal is an artificial canal system in Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh.
Climate-resilient village models combine adaptation, ecosystem restoration, and local livelihood support.
District Climate Change Mission is a district-level mechanism linked to climate action planning in Tamil Nadu.
Corporate Environmental Responsibility refers to private-sector support for environmental projects and restoration activities.
